inputs.name: ProjectRegistryService.constructor.file
inputs.description: Optional path passed to LocalDocumentAdapter for the project registry document. When omitted, the constructor passes undefined, and the service does not validate or normalize the path itself.

inputs.name: ProjectRegistryService.register.directory
inputs.description: Directory sent to git rev-parse --show-toplevel before the repository root is canonicalized with realpath. It must identify a Git work tree and be resolvable by realpath.

inputs.name: ProjectRegistryService.get.id
inputs.description: ID compared with each registered project id using string equality. IDs produced by register use local- followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 characters.

outputs.name: ProjectRegistryService.register
outputs.description: Resolves to the project built from the canonical Git root, using that root’s basename as name and kind local. Its id is local- followed by the lowercase 64-character SHA-256 digest of the root, and repeat registration returns the existing matching record.

outputs.name: ProjectRegistryService.list
outputs.description: Resolves to the persisted project array after checking it is an array and each entry has kind local, a string root, and an id matching local-[a-f0-9]{64}. It does not check that name matches the root or recompute the id from root.

outputs.name: ProjectRegistryService.get
outputs.description: Resolves to the project whose id equals the requested string. It rejects when no matching project exists and propagates failures from list().

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The service throws Error(Invalid project registry.) when list() rejects the persisted shape and Error(Unknown project.) when get() cannot find the requested ID. Rejections from Git lookup, realpath, and document adapter calls in register() or list() propagate.
